\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-21

Let $(M,g)$ be a complete, connected, noncompact Riemannian manifold. Define a ray in $M$ to be a geodesic $\gamma $ whose domain is $[0,\infty )$, and such that the restriction of $\gamma $ to $[0,b]$ is minimizing for every $b > 0$. Prove that for each $p \in M$ there is a ray in $M$ starting at $p$. \end{exercise}
